observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 25 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 176.» (L16) in the left margin.
body L3: the upper dot of the semicolon after «est» is printed faint.
body L22: «gradibns» is printed so, with an n for the u; kept as printed.
body L24: the letter of the reference (b) is bold italic.
notes_left L9: the volume of Halma's Almagest is printed «t. I» here; notes 1 and 5 cite book XIII in volume II; kept as printed.
notes_right L6: يج (13) and يح (18) are the minutes in Arabic letters, each a tooth joined to the jīm or the ḥā'; the two dots of the yā' are printed joined into one short bar under each.
notes_right L8-L9: the Greek is set in a smaller type. In «βοῤῤᾶν» each rho is printed with a breathing of the same form as the smooth breathing of «ἀνιέναι»; kept as printed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
